desc: Derive the GF(2) row/column reduction and parity-DSU counting formula.
Write a compact Python 3 code block (no derivation) implementing the formula with fast input, iterative parity DSU, bytearray parity/col, and pow(2, components, MOD).
Run the code on the sample and small edge cases (all A, all B, odd row/col parity, 2x2) and fix any failures.
